project: Super Mario Galaxy native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Creates a file and plays the first area at 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: the Star Festival, walking and jumping, 54.7 fps with dips to about 40). Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
